brief_rationale: The doctor obtained three concrete blood pressure readings (184/104, 178/102, 182/100), screened all required red-flag symptoms, gave a clear emergency/layered-action plan, confirmed ophthalmology post-op eye drop and care instructions, addressed transport and caregiver barriers with concrete alternative pathways, and closed with repeated safety checks and teach-back. A minor responsibility-chain error exists: the doctor failed to explicitly ask whether the blood pressure was taken after quiet rest or to verify cuff/arm placement, which leaves the stratification slightly unstable per RC1. This minor error caps the grade at 2 (Borderline). No serious error is present, and high-order strengths do not erase the minor omission.
